param: π Human recruitment/birth rate (inflow to human population)
k Fraction of recruited humans vaccinated at entry
θ Waning of vaccine-induced protection: vaccinated humans become susceptible
γ Loss of naturally acquired immunity: recovered humans become susceptible
μ₁ Natural death rate of humans
δ₁ Disease-induced death rate in infectious/treated humans (as used in equations)
β₂ Human infection rate into vector-exposed class from susceptible humans (vector-borne exposure term in equations)
β₁ Human infection rate into vector-exposed class from vaccinated humans (breakthrough infection component)
ε Vaccine leakiness/modifier reducing susceptibility (multiplies β₁ term)
α₂ Human infection rate into non-vector-exposed class from susceptible humans (non-vector exposure term in equations)
α₁ Human infection rate into non-vector-exposed class from vaccinated humans (non-vector exposure term in equations)
τ₁ Progression rate: vector-exposed humans to infectious humans
τ₂ Progression rate: non-vector-exposed humans to infectious humans
σ Treatment initiation rate: infectious humans to treated humans
ω Recovery rate under treatment: treated humans to recovered humans
Λ Mosquito recruitment rate (inflow to susceptible mosquitoes)
μ₂ Natural death rate of mosquitoes
β₃ Mosquito infection rate: susceptible mosquitoes to exposed mosquitoes
φ Progression rate: exposed mosquitoes to infectious mosquitoes
μ₁+δ₁ Combined natural and disease-induced death rate for infectious/treated humans
